reference_sql:
WITH daily AS (  -- one row per campaign and day from July to September 2025
  SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend,
         AVG(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id) AS avg_spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND spend_date <= DATE '2025-09-30'
)
SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend, ROUND(avg_spend, 2) AS campaign_avg
FROM daily
WHERE spend > 1.4 * avg_spend
alternatives:
WITH daily AS (  -- one row per campaign and day from July to September 2025
  SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND spend_date <= DATE '2025-09-30'
),
campaign_avg AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend in the period
  SELECT campaign_id, AVG(spend) AS avg_spend
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY campaign_id
)
SELECT d.campaign_id, d.spend_date, d.spend, ROUND(ca.avg_spend, 2) AS campaign_avg
FROM daily d
JOIN campaign_avg ca ON ca.campaign_id = d.campaign_id
WHERE d.spend > 1.4 * ca.avg_spend

SELECT t.campaign_id, t.spend_date, t.spend, ROUND(t.avg_spend, 2) AS campaign_avg
FROM (
  -- one row per campaign and day from July to September 2025
  SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend,
         AVG(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id) AS avg_spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND spend_date <= DATE '2025-09-30'
) AS t
WHERE t.spend > 1.4 * t.avg_spend

  SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend,
         AVG(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY campaign_id) AS avg_exact
  FROM ad_spend_daily
  WHERE spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND spend_date <= DATE '2025-09-30'
)
SELECT campaign_id, spend_date, spend, ROUND(avg_exact, 2) AS campaign_avg
FROM d
WHERE spend > 1.4 * avg_exact
